label: synthetic, derived (Testnet replay scaled toward Mainnet); not a Mainnet measurement

testnet_replay_range.source: getblock verbosity 1 against the Testnet node, .tmp/spike-results/tools/block-sizes.txt

inputs.source: Blockworks Zcash token holder report Q3 2026, as quoted by https://www.aicoin.com/en/article/555009

recent_tip_by_transaction_count.post_nu7_note: NU7 activated on Mainnet at height 3,543,405 on 2026-11-05 with a 25-second target (https://theblock.co/news/defi/2026-11-06-zcashs-nu7-goes-live-435807); at the Q3 transaction rate a 25-second block carries one third of a 75-second block, so the per-block multiplier falls to about 1.3x (all) or 2.6x (non-coinbase)
recent_tip_by_transaction_count.caveat: transaction count is a proxy for row volume; Mainnet transactions carry more transparent inputs and outputs than Testnet's mostly coinbase-only blocks, so byte volume per transaction is not measured

inputs.mainnet_source: docs/runbooks/initial-sync.md (Wallet construction: the outpoint sorter of a late-2026 Mainnet build from genesis needed about 99 GB)

whole_chain_average_by_transparent_outpo.range_note: the low end assumes the documented 99 GB counts the merge's double footprint (the doc says a multi-run sorter needs about twice its spilled bytes); the Testnet sorter used one run, so its bytes are the spilled bytes
whole_chain_average_by_transparent_outpo.caveat: a whole-chain average includes historical transparent-heavy periods and is not the density of recent tip blocks

multipliers_run.10x: above the recent-tip estimate (3.9x by all transactions, 7.9x by non-coinbase transactions, at 75-second spacing; about a third of that at the 25-second spacing since NU7)
multipliers_run.60x: above the whole-chain per-block estimate (about 25x to 50x)

what_the_multiplier_scales: each synced batch gets (multiplier - 1) x its real byte size of extra rows in a spike_density_ballast column family of the same database; canonical ballast keys are append-only, wallet ballast keys are hash-distributed with 25% deleted 100 writes later and 25% deleted 3,600 writes later; values are real rows sampled from the stores; per-commit CPU (prepare, validation, readback, wallet derivation) is not scaled
